decisions_made: Ticks stay engine frames (header tickUnit 'frame') so intent.observedTick lines up with perception and tick records; the viewer steps between recorded ticks instead.
Results carry the deciding stage via an internal holder in IntentIngress; the agent-loop-v1 result DTO is unchanged, so Fusion is untouched.
Trace agentId is the wire id (PerceptionBuilder.WireAgentId), matching intents.
A trace write error disables tracing rather than throwing, so tracing can never change a decision.
